title: Top 3 Local Metal Bands: Connecticut
contentHtml:
Connecticut has a ton to offer in the world of metal music, especially with the amount of local bands that can be discovered at The Webster Underground opening up for some massive hits.
Here’s a list of what I believe the top 3 local bands are around Connecticut some more popular than others but all based off of what bands have the best content produced.

  1. Currents
Currents is a local band that was formed from Fairfield county, making a huge step into the metal one show at a time, with the hands down best stage presence for a local underground metal group. Currents takes the spot at number one because of the content in their first LP titled “Life//Lost” that was released in February of 2015 with hits like ‘Anxiety’ and ‘Heathen’ and their newest single titled ‘Withered.’ Currents split with previous vocalist Patrizio Arpaia back in June of 2015 and then picked up the new vocalist Brian Wille shortly after. You can see the new vocalist’s sound with the new track ‘Withered’ which is available right now for purchase on iTunes along with their last album “Life//Lost.” Brian has much more to offer live than Patrizio ever did with a killer sound and a lot of interaction.

   2. In Honor Of
In Honor Of is another local band based out of Wallingford that provides some of the best live metal you can see around New England. Heavy vocalist Dan Smallacombe packs quite the punch with his lyrics providing the perfect sense of meaning and complete and utter chaos without putting too much of each for it to stay perfectly metal. Clean vocalist Joe DiPalma can almost sing you to sleep with one of the best clean sounds in all of New England. These guys will crush your eardrums all while singing some tunes that will be stuck in your head for months. In Honor Of has their EP “Iron Giant” that is available now on Bandcamp along with a streamable listening option that provides you with some of the best seven songs you will swear you have ever heard. In Honor Of also just put out a single titled ‘The Pressure’ which is available for purchase right now on iTunes along with their fan favorite single titled ‘Ignorance’ that will make you want to break something. In Honor Of is a band you will look up once and listen to on repeat time and time again with serious potential.

     3. Values
Values is a melodic hardcore/metal band from Enfield that provides a perfect amount of pummeling guitar riffs and mind juggling vocals. Vocalist Michael May drops his lows like no other metal vocalist around, surprisingly enough these men only have 766 fans according to their Facebook page, they’ve performed at The Webster Underground and other venues all around Connecticut. Values has their EP “Violence” available for purchase now on Bandcamp along with a streamable listening option. Values is worth the time to look up, I promise none of you will regret it.

I hope to see all of you metalheads at some local shows sooner than later, you can always tweet at me (@DragonEmojis) with your thoughts and opinions on the artists that I have thrown into this article. Stay Metal!

​

In Honor Of Vocalist Dan Smallacombe Photo Creds: @BrittIsaacson
Values Vocalist Michael May Photo Creds: Michael May
